**Finding addressed — [high, correctness] Required upgrade action commands can disappear from the dashboard drill-down:** The root cause was that the validator's `_PROJECTS_SPEC` (in `command_validation.py`) only knew `add`/`list`/`show`/`remove`, so the manifest's real APPLY command `dontpanic projects backfill-canonical` failed token validation. `upgrade_dashboard._command_fields` therefore parked it on the display-only `operator_command` escape hatch, and `what-now-logic.js` normalizes/renders only `exact_command` — so the apply command silently vanished from the drill-down. I fixed it at the source by extending `_PROJECTS_SPEC` to admit the two real, already-shipping canonical-repo-discovery subcommands — `backfill-canonical` (bool `--dry-run`/`--json`, value `--ledger`/`--evidence`) and `discover` (bool `--json`, value `--window-days`/`--min-count`) — mirroring their actual argparse shapes in `cli.py` (`_projects_backfill_canonical`/`_projects_discover`, dispatched at `_projects_main` and documented in `_PROJECTS_USAGE`).
